plan.title: Week 5

workouts.title: Tempo
workouts.summary: Over/under session including warm-up and cool-down.

workouts.title: Upper Arms
workouts.summary: Biceps and triceps session using dumbbells, barbell or EZ bar, bench and resistance bands.

workouts.title: Easy Run
workouts.summary: Conversational effort; 5:15/km is a ceiling rather than a target.

workouts.title: Race Practice Long Run
workouts.summary: Marathon-specific long run with a controlled target-pace block.

coachGuidance: Keep Friday's 10 km genuinely easy and run by conversational effort.
Preserve freshness for Saturday's long run after a high strength-training week.
Complete the Thursday arm session without adding lower-body fatigue.
Prioritise carbohydrates, hydration and sleep before the long run.

suggestions.suggested: Keep 10 km, but run entirely by conversational effort rather than chasing pace
suggestions.reason: The week already includes multiple strength sessions and two completed quality runs
suggestions.expectedImpact: Preserves freshness for Saturday while retaining the aerobic volume

suggestions.current: 26 km with the full planned marathon-pace block
suggestions.suggested: Keep the original workout if recovery is normal; shorten the marathon-pace block if Friday feels unusually heavy or sleep is poor
suggestions.reason: The long run is the priority session, but forcing the full quality block under elevated fatigue would reduce execution quality
suggestions.expectedImpact: Protects the marathon-specific stimulus while avoiding an unnecessarily costly session
